neighbours.label: intensifier 'much'/'still' (Russian еще) right before a comparative or quantity
fire: Electric cars produce much lower emissions than petrol cars.
The number of retirees is much smaller than the workforce.
This version runs much faster on older laptops.
Он понимал, что эта книга ему может еще пригодиться.
The new bridge is much longer than the old one.
Prices were much higher in the capital.
Her second novel was much better received.
